notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
A creature you control has attacked this turn.
description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
 Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Fain, untapping Fain.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two counters from it, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Repeat.
